answer: A Tide-Bound Umber Thread license stops Sybils by tying identity to slow, checkable work. First, an applicant locks 170 POA for 45 days and files an umber thread dossier of ten verified tasks. Second, two established reviewers stake 55 POA each and audit it within 72 hours, rejecting any copied thread. Third, the license activates only after 12 clean tasks in 30 days; one fraud forfeits the 170 POA plus a 180-day ban. Faking 100 identities locks 17,000 POA and needs 1,200 audited tasks — like flooding a tide gate with paper boats: only boats that already sailed get through.
